name: Muapi
summary: Hosted generative-media MCP: search models; generate and edit images and videos; create audio; and poll jobs. Uses a Muapi bearer API key. Generation can consume credits, and tools also include credit top-ups and API-key management. Grant only the individual tools you want.
publisher: Muapi by Vadoo Internet Services Private Limited
license: Proprietary service; see Muapi Terms of Service
setup_instructions: Create an API key at https://muapi.ai/access-keys. In Open Dots, connect this listing and save the key as its bearer token. Grant only the individual tools each agent needs. Generation can consume credits; the tool set also includes credit top-ups and API-key creation and deletion. Do not paste the key into chat or a tool argument.
test_instructions: Grant search_models to an agent and call it once with a model keyword to verify the connection without starting a paid generation. Avoid generation during connection testing because it can consume credits. Remove the grant if the agent does not need the search tool.
